title: The Forgotten Kingdom
summary: Ha-Jun explores the ancient ruins of Necrothea, uncovering murals of the First Sovereign's golden age and discovering that his brother Tae-Jun was captured by the Three Demon Lords.

panels.shot: grand boulevard of necrothea wide shot
panels.action: A 100-meter-wide grand ceremonial avenue paved in polished black volcanic glass, flanked by towering statues.
panels.prose_en: A 100-meter-wide grand ceremonial avenue paved in polished black volcanic glass, flanked by towering statues.
panels.prose_hi: Polish kiye gaye kale jwalamukhiya kaanch se bana 100 meter chauda bhavya aupcharik marg, jiske donon or unchi-unchi moortiyan han.

panels.shot: abandoned palatial buildings with crystalline spires
panels.action: Crumbling palaces of dark obsidian and amethyst crystal, silent monuments to a fallen golden empire.
panels.prose_en: Crumbling palaces of dark obsidian and amethyst crystal, silent monuments to a fallen golden empire.
panels.prose_hi: Gahre obsidian aur neelam crystal ke dhahte mahal, gire hue sunhare samrajya ke mook smarak.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking down the center of the avenue
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks down the road, his boots clicking rhythmically on the mirror-smooth black glass.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks down the road, his boots clicking rhythmically on the mirror-smooth black glass.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sadak par chalta hai, uske jute darpan jaise chikne kale sheeshe par taal se takra rahe han.

panels.shot: kuro fluttering from statue to statue
panels.action: Kuro glides ahead, his eyes filled with nostalgic sorrow: 'Yahan 10 million demons rehte the ek waqt par.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: First Sovereign ke era mein yeh kingdom celestial realms se bhi zyada glorious tha.

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides ahead, his eyes filled with nostalgic sorrow: 'Yahan 10 million demons rehte the ek waqt par.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro aage badhta hai, uski aankhen purane dukh se bhar jaati han: 'yahan 10 million rakshas rahte hain ek waqt par.'

panels.shot: ha-jun pausing before a massive triumphal archway
panels.action: A 150-foot archway carved with intricate narrative bas-relief murals depicting the ancient wars.
panels.prose_en: A 150-foot archway carved with intricate narrative bas-relief murals depicting the ancient wars.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin yuddhon ko darshane wali jatil kathaatmak aadhar-rahat bhittichitron ke saath ukera gaya 150 foot ka torandwar.

panels.shot: mural depicting the seven demon kings rebelling
panels.action: The stone mural shows seven horned kings turning their blades against a single crowned sovereign figure.

dialogue.text: Seven Demon Kings ne First Sovereign ke vishwaas ko toda... Aur realm ko do hisso mein baant diya.

panels.prose_en: The stone mural shows seven horned kings turning their blades against a single crowned sovereign figure.
panels.prose_hi: Patthar ke bhitti chitr mein saat seeng wale rajaon ko ek hi mukutdhari samprabhu aakriti ke viruddh apne blade ghumate hue dikhaya gaya hai.

panels.shot: mural showing the sovereign sealing his ten relics
panels.action: The First Sovereign carving out his own heart and marrow, sealing his supreme authority into ten relics.
panels.prose_en: The First Sovereign carving out his own heart and marrow, sealing his supreme authority into ten relics.
panels.prose_hi: Pratham samprabhu ne apne hriday aur majja ko tarashkar, apne sarvochch adhikar ko das avsheshon mein seal kar diya.

panels.shot: ha-jun touching the mural with reverence
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingertips trace the relief of the sovereign's face; a psychic jolt ripples into his mind.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Woh betrayed the... Apne hi senapatiyo ke haatho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fingertips trace the relief of the sovereign's face; a psychic jolt ripples into his mind.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki ungaliyan samprabhu ke chehre ki rahat ka pata lagati han; uske man mein ek mansik jhatka lagta hai.

panels.shot: glowing red footsteps continuing past the arch
panels.action: Tae-Jun's crimson mana footprints lead off the main boulevard toward an underground amphitheater.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's crimson mana footprints lead off the main boulevard toward an underground amphitheater.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ke lal man pairon ke nishan mukhya buleward se bhumigat emphitheater ki or le jaate han.

panels.shot: signs of recent violent struggle on the pavement
panels.action: Deep slash marks in the glass street, black demon blood splattered across a broken obelisk.
panels.prose_en: Deep slash marks in the glass street, black demon blood splattered across a broken obelisk.
panels.prose_hi: Kanch ki sadak par gahre chot ke nishan, toote hue smarak-stambh par faila hua kala danav ka khun.

panels.shot: ha-jun kneeling to inspect black blood
panels.action: Ha-Jun dips a finger in the fresh, still-smoking demon blood: 'Yeh blood sirf do ghante purana hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai yahan kisi se lade the. Aur unka dushman kamzor nahi tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun dips a finger in the fresh, still-smoking demon blood: 'Yeh blood sirf do ghante purana hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne taaja, abhi bhi sulag rahe danav khoon mein ek ungli duboi: 'ye khoon sirf do ghante purana hai.'

panels.shot: kuro inspecting the slash marks
panels.action: Kuro's eyes widen: 'Shadow scythe marks... Valac ke Shadow Assassins!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Demon Lord Valac ne apne elite hunters ko bheja tha Tae-Jun ko capture karne ke liye!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes widen: 'Shadow scythe marks... Valac ke Shadow Assassins!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki aankhen chaudi ho gain: 'chhaya ke nishan... valack ke chhaya hatyare!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun finding a torn piece of white fabric
panels.action: Caught on a jagged stone: a torn scrap of a white hospital patient gown, stained with dried blood.
panels.prose_en: Caught on a jagged stone: a torn scrap of a white hospital patient gown, stained with dried blood.
panels.prose_hi: Ek dantedar patthar par pakda gaya: aspataal ke marij ke safed gown ka fata hua tukda, sukhe khoon se sana hua.

panels.shot: ha-jun clutching the fabric to his chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun clutches the cloth tightly, his eyes blazing with fury: 'Unhone bhai ko capture kar liya hai...'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main bohot kareeb tha... Sirf do ghante late!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clutches the cloth tightly, his eyes blazing with fury: 'Unhone bhai ko capture kar liya hai...'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne kapde ko kaskar pakad liya, uski aankhen gusse se chamak uthin: 'anhone bhai ko pakad liya hai...'.

panels.shot: kuro flying onto ha-jun forearm
panels.action: Kuro reassures him firmly: 'Woh use maarenge nahi, Ha-Jun! Unhe uske blood se Relics ko unseal karna hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun safe hai jab tak unke paas bache hue relics nahi hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro reassures him firmly: 'Woh use maarenge nahi, Ha-Jun! Unhe uske blood se Relics ko unseal karna hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne use dridhta se aashvast kiya: 'vo use marenge nahin, Ha-Jun! unko khoon se avsheshon ko kholna hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking toward the amphitheater entrance
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks toward the subterranean archway: 'Aur agla Relic yahan niche hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Fang of Abyss... Yahi hai na?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks toward the subterranean archway: 'Aur agla Relic yahan niche hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bhumigat torandwar ki or dekhta hai: 'aur agla avashesh yahan neeche hai?'.

panels.shot: kuro nodding with sharp determination
panels.action: Kuro confirms: 'Amphitheater ke Vault of Severance mein. The Fang of Abyss.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Agar humne woh dagger claim kar liya, toh hum kisi bhi dimensional barrier ko cheer sakte hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro confirms: 'Amphitheater ke Vault of Severance mein. The Fang of Abyss.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne pushti ki: 'emfitheater ke walt off sevrence men. rasatal ka daant.'

panels.shot: ha-jun standing to full height
panels.action: Ha-Jun pockets his brother's cloth scrap, his bone gauntlet glowing ready for war.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pockets his brother's cloth scrap, his bone gauntlet glowing ready for war.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne bhai ke kapde ke tukde ko jeb mein rakh liya, uski haddi ka kavach yudh ke liye taiyar hokar chamak raha tha.

panels.shot: descending massive stone staircase into amphitheater
panels.action: Ha-Jun descends a sweeping circular staircase that wraps around a colossal sunken colosseum.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun descends a sweeping circular staircase that wraps around a colossal sunken colosseum.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek vyapak golakar sidhi se utarta hai jo ek vishal dhanse hue colosium ke charon or lapetati hai.

panels.shot: sunken colosseum arena reveal
panels.action: A 200-meter circular gladiatorial arena paved in white petrified bones, surrounded by shattered spectator thrones.
panels.prose_en: A 200-meter circular gladiatorial arena paved in white petrified bones, surrounded by shattered spectator thrones.
panels.prose_hi: Safed pathrili haddiyon se bana 200 meter ka golakar gladatorial kshetra, toote hue darshak sinhasanon se ghira hua hai.

panels.shot: pedestal in arena center holding black crystal prism
panels.action: In the dead center of the arena, an obsidian obelisk suspends a floating 3-foot rhomboid crystal prism.
panels.prose_en: In the dead center of the arena, an obsidian obelisk suspends a floating 3-foot rhomboid crystal prism.
panels.prose_hi: Akhade ke mrit kendra men, ek obsidian obilisk ek tairte hue 3-fut romboid crystal prism ko nilambit karta hai.

panels.shot: inside prism: the fang of abyss
panels.action: Sealed inside the crystal: an eight-inch jagged curved dagger forged from solid midnight void matter.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: THE FANG OF ABYSS (RARE RELIC)]
Authority: Spatial Severance & Void Piercing
Guardian Status: ACTIVE / EN ROUTE

panels.prose_en: Sealed inside the crystal: an eight-inch jagged curved dagger forged from solid midnight void matter.
panels.prose_hi: Cristal ke andar sil: ek aath inch ka dantedar ghumavdar khanjar jo thos aadhi raat ke shunya padarth se bana hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping onto arena floor
panels.action: The moment Ha-Jun's boot touches the bone tiles, a low subsonic vibration rattles the colosseum pillars.
panels.prose_en: The moment Ha-Jun's boot touches the bone tiles, a low subsonic vibration rattles the colosseum pillars.
panels.prose_hi: Jis kshan Ha-Jun ka boot haddi ki tailon ko chhuta hai, ek kam subsonic kampan colosium stambhon ko hilata hai.

panels.shot: kuro looking up at the dark amphitheater dome
panels.action: Kuro's feathers bristle: 'Upar dekho! The Apex Guardian!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro's feathers bristle: 'Upar dekho! The Apex Guardian!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ke pankh fadak uthe: 'upar dekho! sheersh sanrshak!'.

panels.shot: colossal 40-foot abyssal void dragon dropping
panels.action: Coiled like a bat among the high gothic vaults, a 40-foot Void Dragon unfurls its wings and drops.
panels.prose_en: Coiled like a bat among the high gothic vaults, a 40-foot Void Dragon unfurls its wings and drops.
panels.prose_hi: Unchi gothic tahkhanon ke beech chamgadad ki tarah kundlit, 40 foot ka shunya dragon apne pankh failata hai aur girta hai.

panels.shot: dragon slamming onto arena floor
panels.action: The colossal beast lands with catastrophic weight, fracturing bones and sending shockwaves across the colosseum.
panels.prose_en: The colossal beast lands with catastrophic weight, fracturing bones and sending shockwaves across the colosseum.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal janwar vinashkari vajan ke saath utarta hai, haddiyan tod deta hai aur colosium mein sadme ki laharen bhej deta hai.

panels.shot: void dragon design close-up
panels.action: Sleek obsidian scales, four glowing indigo eyes, an elongated serpentine neck, and wings made of starry void space.
panels.prose_en: Sleek obsidian scales, four glowing indigo eyes, an elongated serpentine neck, and wings made of starry void space.
panels.prose_hi: Chikne obsidian taraju, char chamakti neel aankhen, ek lambi sarpin gardan, aur taron se bhare shunya sthan se bane pankh.

panels.shot: dragon throat glowing with blinding violet antimatter
panels.action: The dragon's neck swells with blinding violet energy as it charges a full-power Spatial Breath beam.
panels.prose_en: The dragon's neck swells with blinding violet energy as it charges a full-power Spatial Breath beam.
panels.prose_hi: Dragon ki gardan andhi baingani urja se suj jaati hai kyonki yah ek purn-shakti sthanik shwas kiran ko charge karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting dual bloodfire katanas
panels.action: Ha-Jun crosses his twin flaming blades before him, irises blazing with fearless resolve.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Pehle ek guardian centurion... Ab ek dragon. Bring it on!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun crosses his twin flaming blades before him, irises blazing with fearless resolve.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne donon jwalant bledon ko apne samne rakhta hai, nidar sankalp ke saath dhadhakti hui aankhon ki putliyon ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: spatial breath beam erupting from dragon maw
panels.action: A 10-meter-wide beam of pure space-deleting violet void fire blasts straight at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: A 10-meter-wide beam of pure space-deleting violet void fire blasts straight at Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun mein shuddh antriksh-hatane wali baingani shunya aag ki 10 meter chaudi kiran sidhe visfot karti hai.
